messages.subject: Priors on thresholds when using the cumulative link for ordinal regression

messages.subject: Re: Priors on thresholds when using the cumulative link for ordinal regression
parts: After fitting the model, run stancode(fit) to see the priors being applied. They are pretty uninformative and just help the model to converge better.
